description: This file defines a Spring service class to handle the reversal of transactions on savings accounts within the Apache Fineract project. It implements the command handler interface and delegates the core logic to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ReverseTransactionSavingsAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for handling reversal commands on savings account transactions.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reversal command by extracting transaction details from the input JSON and delegating the reversal operation to the write platform service.
